notes: **Fact.** Transpose (AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ. Inverse: A⁻¹ = adj(A)/det(A) (2×2: [d −b; −c a]/(ad−bc)).
**Fact.** Properties: det(AB) = det A·det B; det A⁻¹ = 1/det A; det kA = kⁿ det A for n×n.
**Fact.** Cofactors: Cᵢⱼ = (−1)^{i+j} Mᵢⱼ; adj = cofactor matrix transposed; A·adj(A) = det(A) I.
